gpu.tooltip: Desktop is on %1. Next login uses %2.
gpu.title: Desktop GPU
gpu.autoHint: NVIDIA when a screen is plugged into it, and Intel when the laptop is on its own.
gpu.intelHint: The desktop stays on Intel, so the NVIDIA GPU can idle.
gpu.nvidiaHint: The desktop renders on the NVIDIA GPU.
gpu.noApps: No app is drawing on a GPU
gpu.appLaunch: A choice applies the next time that app starts.
gpu.appDesktopTip: Follows the desktop GPU. It applies the next time this app starts.
gpu.advanced: Show the GPU choice for each app
gpu.appNoLauncher: Saved. This program has no menu entry to attach it to.
gpu.appsNote: An app can still choose the other GPU.
gpu.logoutDetail: This closes your apps and signs you out.
gpu.readFailed: Could not read which GPU is in use.
gpu.writeFailed: Could not save the GPU choice.
